_notes: What UQM 0.8.0 draws in a battle, recorded by the battle program (tools/extract/golden/battle.c; battle.json's notes say how it runs a battle) built with RECORD_DRAW: its drawing calls are recorded rather than stubbed. The battles are the flagship (sis_ship.c) against the Ilwrath (ilwrath.c), flown by pilots (their keys recorded in input, as battle-ships.json's), with the captain's windows and status icons loaded (load_ship's battle data).
sheets: the battle program's (battle.json), then the captains' windows and icons and graphics.status (StatusFrame), numbered.
views: each frame's [seed, scroll x, y, zoom_out, view (0 stable, 1 scrolled, 2 zoomed, -1 the first), SpaceOrg x, y], as battle.json's frames begin.

drawn: each frame's [status, space]. status: the status panel's calls in StatusContext as status.c and shipstat.c make them, in its own coordinates, in order: ["s", sheet, frame, x, y] DrawStamp, ["f", sheet, frame, x, y, r, g, b] DrawFilledStamp, ["r", x, y, w, h, r, g, b] DrawFilledRectangle, ["o", ...] DrawRectangle, ["t", font, x, y, align, text, r, g, b] font_DrawText (fonts named; a ship's race strings read "string N", N the table's index; the flagship's names Vindicator and Zelnick); a sheet of -1 is no frame. space: DrawBatch's primitives as it draws the display list, in order, each [type (0 point, 1 stamp, 2 filled stamp, 3 line), x, y, a line's second x, y (else 0), sheet, frame (else -1), colour (RGB15, -1 never set)], at the display coordinates PostProcessQueue and MoveGalaxy gave them; then the graphic scale it's drawn at (SetGraphicScale: 0 none).
